name: zclipalt_build_frustum_planes
description: zClipAlt_BuildFrustumPlanes transforms six local camera frustum normals into world-space frustum normals using the camera world transform.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this frustum-plane helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zGeometry/zVideo camera-source pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x47a1d0 validates pushing cameraData->worldTransform, transforming six contiguous local frustum normals at offset 0x13c into worldFrustumNormals at offset 0x188 with zMath_Mat_TransformNormalBatch, popping the matrix stack, and returning.
The native camera smoke verifies canonical local frustum normals transformed by an identity world transform into the six world frustum normal slots.
